about.title: Understand the field before writing code
body: My path is not linear — graphic arts, industry, customer relations, entrepreneurship and then software development. That is precisely what helps me connect technical constraints with operational reality.

I design and maintain tools used every day, covering the full scope: development, software architecture, infrastructure, network and hardware. I favor explicit architecture, strong typing, passive views and validation that genuinely reflects production.
